definitions.explanation: a line running from top to bottom, used in drawing, design, writing, charts, and everyday descriptions

examples.japanese: {縦線|たてせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縦線|たてせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曲|ま}がっている→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧。
examples.english: The vertical lines in the table are crooked.

examples.japanese: ⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{縦線|たてせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追加|ついか}して→追加する：19646_tsuikasuru⟧、⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ごと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区切|くぎ}り→区切り：21082_kugiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすく⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I added vertical lines to the graph to make the divisions between periods clearer.

notes:
Combines ⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧ (vertical, lengthwise) and ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line). A basic term used in geometry, design, calligraphy, and everyday contexts. Contrasts with ⟦{横線|よこせん}→横線：18546_yokosen⟧ (horizontal line).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦線|たてせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a vertical line
- {縦線|たてせん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{横線|よこせん}→横線：18546_yokosen⟧: vertical and horizontal lines
- ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧{縦線|たてせん}: a thick vertical line
- ⟦{点線|てんせん}→点線：18308_tensen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縦線|たてせん}: a dotted vertical line

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{横線|よこせん}→横線：18546_yokosen⟧: horizontal line — the counterpart running left to right
- ⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧: straight line — a line with no curves, not necessarily vertical
- ⟦{斜線|しゃせん}→斜線：08120_shasen⟧: diagonal line; slash — a line running at an angle
